purpose: E1 acceptance for K_v2 with the primitive in use: every stage-boundary checkpoint of an episode whose locate goes through the K3 primitive resumes to the same episode, replaying the source episode's cached replies (replay=True). Harness check only.
task_choice: The first generated instance of the two templates with the full chain, fixed before the smoke run; if either was rejected at prepare (ready false) the check stops and a new config is registered.
physical_episodes: one fresh source episode per task (live model calls) plus one resume per written checkpoint (at most 10 per task, no model calls)
prediction: Every resume reproduces its source episode under tabletop.same_episode, with no ReplayCacheMiss: the locate and prepare relocate frames render to the same bytes, so both replies come from the source episode's vlm_cache.
falsification: Any ReplayCacheMiss (the replayed frame differs from the source frame) or any differing record. Either blocks K_v2 use in checkpoint-based work (entry library, reach trials) until the cause is found.
